comparison.objective: Assembles a door lever set and drives two mounting screws while keeping the outside lever level; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2018 combines hidden spindle/post insertion, opposing-part assembly, and stabilization of a large lever during separate screw driving; the candidate counterholds concentric threaded elements with two tools.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2018 requires seated roses, snug screws, and lever/hub level within 1° after release; the candidate requires a locked 90° stop retained through three actuation cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared counterholding primitive is generic; separate-screw lockset assembly does not test preserving a threaded adjuster against its coaxial jam nut or verifying stop retention through cycles.

review_notes: Lever-set assembly: counterhold outsidelever level while two screws driven. Compare two-hand torque stabilization versus coupled adjuster setpoint; no automatic distinct.
